scenes.name: What gets in the way, up front
scenes.screen: The heading, then the two problems drop in one by one, numbered, so the viewer knows what is coming.

scenes.name: Problems 1 and 2
scenes.screen: Recipe tabs pile up and the pointer hunts across them; then the list is typed by hand, one item at a time, and an empty slot gets a red cross.

scenes.name: The answer, and the line to remember
scenes.screen: The same tabs, still dimmed, light up and fly into one list; every item is there and ticked; then the closing line.

lines.text: Two things make weekly shopping slow.
The recipes are scattered across tabs.
And the list gets typed by hand, so something is always missing.
Here, the recipes become one list, with nothing left out.
